You could die before you even reach a small black hole.
But a giant one gives you twelve point eight seconds. Why?
Gravity pulls your feet harder than your head.
Near a small black hole, that difference can rip you apart before you reach the edge.
A giant one, like the one NASA simulated, lets you cross the edge in one piece.
Then, twelve point eight seconds later: spaghetti.
And what your friend sees is even stranger. Full video on the channel.
